author: Sem04
quote:
GTA VI feels very dissappointing considering how long we waited for the game.
Graphics might be amazing (but also quite bland), but not even hitting 30 FPS all the time, even dropping into lower 20 FPS is something that shouldnt even happen in a game released in 2026 where games are expected to hit minimum 60 FPS.
I cant add much to the story since I havent played all the way through (am at roughly 40-60%) and it has it highs, but the segments between the highs are really tiresome and boring most of the times.
The gameplay and the mission deisgn was what most worried me since Rockstar always lacked when it came to them. And what can I say, its still a huge problem. The gameplay feels stiff, not very free and the mission design is still lacking depth and decision making, especially when comparing it to smaller games who do it 100x better.

The game is one of the most anticipated games of the century with I think the biggest budget, but while you play it you just constantly ask yourself where did that development time and budget went, because they didnt really improve on what makes the game fun.

author: Sem04
quote: I never played the original so this feels like a completely new Zelda game to me. Nintendo is doing here what they always do best, pushing its hardware to its limit like they did with most Switch 1 games, and in combination with a game that always was critcally acclaimed, they created a brand new but also familiar experience
